verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ በዓመት፡ በዘሞተ፡ ዖዝያን፡ ንጉሥ፡ ርኢክዎ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ እንዘ፡ ይነብር፡ ዲበ፡ መንበሩ፡ ልዑል፡ ወነዋኅ፣፡ ወምሉእ፡ ቤተ፡ ስብሐቲሁ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass in the year in which king Ozias died, that I saw the Lord sitting on a high and exalted throne, and the house was full of his glory.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass in the year in which king Ozias died, that I saw the Lord sitting on a high and exalted throne, and the house was full of his glory.
translations.kjv: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the LORD sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
translations.ron: În anul morţii regelui Ozia, am văzut pe Domnul stând pe un scaun înalt şi măreţ şi poalele hainelor Lui umpleau templul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένετο τοῦ ἐνιαυτοῦ οὗ ἀπέθανεν Ὀζίας ὁ βασιλεὺς, εἶδον τὸν Κύριον καθήμενον ἐπὶ θρόνου ὑψηλοῦ καὶ ἐπῃρμένου· καὶ πλήρης ὁ οἶκος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወሱራፌም፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ዐውዶ፤ ለለ፡ አሐዱ፡ አሐዱ፡ ስድስቱ፡ ክነፊሆሙ፤ ወበክልኤቱ፡ ይከድኑ፡ ገጾሙ፡ ወበክልኤቱ፡ ይከድኑ፡ እገሪሆሙ፡ ወበክልኤቱ፡ ይሰሩ።
verses.translation: And seraphs stood round about him: each one had six wings: and with two they covered their face, and with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.

translations.lxx: And seraphs stood round about him: each one had six wings: and with two they covered their face, and with two they covered their feet, and with two they flew.
translations.kjv: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
translations.ron: Serafimi stăteau înaintea Lui, fiecare având câte şase aripi: cu două îşi acopereau feţele, cu două picioarele, iar cu două zburau
translations.grk: Καὶ σεραφὶμ εἱστήκεισαν κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ, ἓξ πτέρυγες τῷ ἑνὶ, καὶ ἓξ πτέρυγες τῷ ἑνί· καὶ ταῖς μὲν δυσὶ, κατεκάλυπτον τὸ πρόσωπον· ταῖς δὲ δυσὶ κατεκάλυπτον τοὺς πόδας· καὶ ταῖς δυσὶν ἐπέταντο.

verses.geez: ወይኬልሑ፡ አሐዱ፡ አሐዱ፡ ምስለ፡ ካልኡ፡ ወይብሉ፤ ቅዱስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፣፡ መልአ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምድረ፡ ስብሐቲከ።
verses.translation: And one cried to the other, and they said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

translations.lxx: And one cried to the other, and they said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
translations.kjv: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the LORD of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
translations.ron: Şi strigau unul către altul, zicând: "Sfânt, sfânt, sfânt este Domnul Savaot, plin este tot pământul de slava Lui!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκέκραγεν ἕτερος πρὸς τὸν ἕτερον, καὶ ἔλεγον, ἅγιος ἅγιος ἅγιος Κύριος σαβαὼθ, πλήρης πᾶσα ἡ γῆ τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ተለዐለ፡ መርፈቀ፡ ኆኅት፡ እምቃል፡ ዘይኬልሑ፡ ወመልአ፡ ቤት፡ ጢሰ።
verses.translation: And the lintel shook at the voice they uttered, and the house was filled with smoke.

translations.lxx: And the lintel shook at the voice they uttered, and the house was filled with smoke.
translations.kjv: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
translations.ron: Din pricina acestor strigăte, porţile se zguduiau din ţâţânele lor, iar templul s-a umplut de fum.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπῄρθη τὸ ὑπέρθυρον ἀπὸ τῆς φωνῆς ἧς ἐκέκραγον, καὶ ὁ οἶκος ἐνεπλήσθη καπνοῦ.

verses.geez: ወእቤ፤ ኦአነ፡ ሕርቱም፡ እስመ፡ ሰብእ፡ አነ፡ ወደንገፅኩ፡ እስመ፡ ርኩስ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ ወማእከለ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ዘርኩስ፡ ከናፍሪሁ፡ ሀለውኩ፡ አነ፤ ወእምዝ፡ ርኢክዎ፡ በአዕይንትየ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ ንጉሥ።
verses.translation: And I said, Woe is me, for I am pricked to the heart; for being a man, and having unclean lips, I dwell in the midst of a people having unclean lips; and I have seen with mine eyes the King, the Lord of hosts.

translations.lxx: And I said, Woe is me, for I am pricked to the heart; for being a man, and having unclean lips, I dwell in the midst of a people having unclean lips; and I have seen with mine eyes the King, the Lord of hosts.
translations.kjv: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the LORD of hosts.
translations.ron: Şi am zis: "Vai mie, că sunt pierdut! Sunt om cu buze spurcate şi locuiesc în mijlocul unui popor cu buze necurate. Şi pe Domnul Savaot L-am văzut cu ochii mei!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπον, ὢ τάλας ἐγώ, ὅτι κατανένυγμαι, ὅτι ἄνθρωπος ὢν, καὶ ἀκάθαρτα χείλη ἔχων, ἐν μέσῳ λαοῦ ἀκάθαρτα χείλη ἔχοντος ἐγὼ οἰκῶ, καὶ τὸν βασιλέα Κύριον σαβαὼθ εἶδον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς μου.

verses.geez: ወተፈነወ፡ ኀቤየ፡ አሐዱ፡ እምሱራፌም፡ ወውስተ፡ እዴሁ፡ ፍሕም፡ ዘነሥአ፡ በጕጠት፡ እምሥዋዕ።
verses.translation: And there was sent to me one of the seraphs, and he had in his hand a coal, which he had taken off the altar with the tongs:

translations.lxx: And there was sent to me one of the seraphs, and he had in his hand a coal, which he had taken off the altar with the tongs:
translations.kjv: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
translations.ron: Atunci unul dintre serafimi a zburat spre mine, având în mâna sa un cărbune, pe care îl luase cu cleştele de pe jertfelnic.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπεστάλη πρὸς μὲ ἓν τῶν σεραφὶμ, καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρὶ εἶχεν ἄνθρακα, ὃν τῇ λαβίδι ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου,

verses.geez: ወአልከፈኒ፡ ከናፍርየ፡ ወይቤለኒ፤ ናሁ፡ አልከፍኩከ፡ ከናፍሪከ፡ ዘንተ፡ ወአእተትኩ፡ ኃጣውኢከ፡ ወአበሳከሂ፡ ያነጽኀሐከ።
verses.translation: and he touched my mouth, and said, Behold, this has touched thy lips, and will take away thine iniquities, and will purge off thy sins.

translations.lxx: and he touched my mouth, and said, Behold, this has touched thy lips, and will take away thine iniquities, and will purge off thy sins.
translations.kjv: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
translations.ron: Şi l-a apropiat de gura mea şi a zis: "Iată s-a atins de buzele tale şi va şterge toate păcatele tale, şi fărădelegile tale le va curăţi".
translations.grk: καὶ ἥψατο τοῦ στόματός μου, καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ ἥψατο τοῦτο τῶν χειλέων σου, καὶ ἀφελεῖ τὰς ἀνομίας σου, καὶ τὰς ἁμαρτίας σου περικαθαριεῖ.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ሰማዕኩ፡ ቃለ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ጸባኦት፡ እንዘ፡ ይብል፤ መነ፡ እፌኑ፡ ወመኑ፡ የሐውር፡ ኀበዝ፡ ሕዝብ፤ ወእቤ፤ ነየ፡ አነ፡ እግዚእየ፡ ፈንወኒ።
verses.translation: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, I am here, send me. And he said, Go, and say to this people,

translations.lxx: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go to this people? And I said, Behold, I am here, send me. And he said, Go, and say to this people,
translations.kjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
translations.ron: Şi am auzit glasul Domnului care zicea: "Pe cine îl voi trimite şi cine va merge pentru Noi?" Şi am răspuns: "Iată-mă, trimite-mă pe mine!"
translations.grk: Καὶ ἤκουσα τῆς φωνῆς Κυρίου λέγοντος, τίνα ἀποστείλω, καὶ τίς πορεύσεται πρὸς τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον; καὶ εἶπα, ἰδοὺ ἐγώ εἰμι· ἀπόστειλόν με.

verses.geez: ወይቤለኒ፤ ሖር፡ ኀበ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወበሎሙ፤ ሰሚዐ፡ ትሰምዑ፡ ወኢትሌብዉ፤ ወርእየ፡ ትሬእዩ፡ ወኢተአምሩ።
verses.translation: Ye shall hear indeed, but ye shall not understand; and ye shall see indeed, but ye shall not perceive.

translations.lxx: Ye shall hear indeed, but ye shall not understand; and ye shall see indeed, but ye shall not perceive.
translations.kjv: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
translations.ron: Şi El a zis: "Du-te şi spune poporului acestuia: Cu auzul veţi auzi şi nu veţi înţelege şi, uitându-vă, vă veţi uita, dar nu veţi vedea.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε, πορεύθητι, καὶ εἰπὸν τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ, ἀκοῇ ἀκούσετε, καὶ οὐ μὴ συνῆτε, καὶ βλέποντες βλέψετε, καὶ οὐ μὴ ἴδητε.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ አግዘፉ፡ ልቦሙ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ወጤዑ፡ እዘኒሆሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይስምዑ፤ ወከደኑ፡ ዐይኖሙ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይርአዩ፡ በአዕይንቲሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ኢይስምዑ፡ በእዘኒሆሙ፡ ወኢይለብዉ፡ በልቦሙ፡ ወኢይትመየጡ፡ ወኢይሠሀሎሙ።
verses.translation: For the heart of this people has become gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.

translations.lxx: For the heart of this people has become gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes have they closed; lest they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
translations.kjv: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
translations.ron: Că s-a învârtoşat inima poporului acestuia şi cu urechile sale greu a auzit şi ochii săi i-a închis, ca nu cumva să vadă cu ochii şi cu urechile să audă şi cu inima să înţeleagă şi să se întoarcă la Mine şi să-l vindec".
translations.grk: Ἐπαχύνθη γὰρ ἡ καρδία τοῦ λαοῦ τούτου, καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτῶν βαρέως ἤκουσαν, καὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐκάμμυσαν· μήποτε ἴδωσι τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς, καὶ τοῖς ὠσὶν ἀκούσωσι, καὶ τῇ καρδίᾳ συνῶσι καὶ ἐπιστρέψωσι, καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς.

verses.geez: ወእቤ፡ አነ፤ እስከ፡ ማእዜኑ፡ እግዚኦ፤ ወይቤለኒ፤ እስከ፡ ይትመዘበር፡ አህጉር፡ ወአልቦ፡ እንከ፡ ዘይነብር፡ ውስተ፡ አብያት፣፡ ወትተርፍ፡ ባሕቲታ፡ ምድር፡ ከመ፡ በድው።
verses.translation: And I said, How long, O Lord? And he said, Until the cities be deserted by reason of their not being inhabited, and the houses by reason of there being no men, and the land shall be left desolate.

translations.lxx: And I said, How long, O Lord? And he said, Until the cities be deserted by reason of their not being inhabited, and the houses by reason of there being no men, and the land shall be left desolate.
translations.kjv: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
translations.ron: Şi am zis: "Până când, Doamne!" Atunci El mi-a răspuns: "Până când cetăţile vor fi pustiite şi vor rămâne fără locuitori, şi casele fără oameni şi pământul pustiu;
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπα, ἕως πότε Κύριε; καὶ εἶπεν, ἕως ἂν ἐρημωθῶσι πόλεις παρὰ τὸ μὴ κατοικεῖσθαι, καὶ οἶκοι παρὰ τὸ μὴ εἶναι ἀνθρώπους, καὶ ἡ γῆ καταλειφθήσεται ἔρημος.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ፡ ያነውኆ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ለሰብእ፡ ወይበዝኁ፡ እለ፡ ተርፉ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር።
verses.translation: And after this God shall remove the men far off, and they that are left upon the land shall be multiplied.

translations.lxx: And after this God shall remove the men far off, and they that are left upon the land shall be multiplied.
translations.kjv: And the LORD have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
translations.ron: Până când Domnul va izgoni pe oameni şi pustiirea va fi mare în mijlocul acestei ţări.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα μακρυνεῖ ὁ Θεὸς τοὺς ἀνθρώπους, καὶ πληθυνθήσονται οἱ ἐγκαταλειφθέντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς·

verses.geez: ወይከውኑ፡ ትዕሥርተ፡ ወካዕበ፡ ይትሐበለይዋ፣፡ ወትከውን፡ ከመ፡ ዕፀ፡ ጠርቤንቶስ፡ ወከመ፡ ዕፀወ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ ሶበ፡ ይነግፍ፡ ቍጸሊሆሙ።
verses.translation: And yet there shall be a tenth upon it, and again it shall be for a spoil, as a turpentine tree, and as an acorn when it falls out of its husk.

translations.lxx: And yet there shall be a tenth upon it, and again it shall be for a spoil, as a turpentine tree, and as an acorn when it falls out of its husk.
translations.kjv: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
translations.ron: Şi dacă va rămâne încă unul din zece, şi acela va fi hărăzit focului, ca şi terebintul şi stejarul, ale căror trunchiuri sunt trântite la pământ. Din butucul rămas va lăstări o mlădiţă sfântă".
translations.grk: καὶ ἔτι ἐπʼ αὐτῆς ἐστι τὸ ἐπιδέκατον, καὶ πάλιν ἔσται εἰς προνομὴν ὡς τερέβινθος, καὶ ὡς βάλανος ὅταν ἐκπέσῃ ἐκ τῆς θήκης αὐτῆς.

note: Isaiah's throne vision in the Temple. Read alongside Ascension of Isaiah 3-5 for the prophet's journey through seven heavens, and alongside 1 Enoch 14 for the earliest Jewish throne vision.
